ei.title: 2번: A Board Game from an Ancient Grave
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an (A)[expected / unexpected] item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was (B)[poor / wealthy]. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was (C)[educated / uneducated] and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) unexpected=예상치 못한 / expected=예상된 (B) wealthy=부유한 / poor=가난한 (C) educated=교육받은 / uneducated=교육받지 못한
det.analysis:
① expected—poor—educated: (A) however와 함께 '뜻밖의' 물건이므로 unexpected
② unexpected—wealthy—educated: 뜻밖의 물건 + 부유했다는 표시 + 교육받은 사람만 놀 수 있었다 ←정답
③ unexpected—poor—uneducated: (B)(C) 부유/교육받은이 문맥
④ expected—wealthy—uneducated: (A)(C) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: however(그러나) 뒤 뜻밖의(unexpected) 물건 → 부유함(wealthy)의 표시 → 교육받은(educated) 사람

questions.passage: One (A)[mistake / tradition] found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an (B)[indication / denial] that the dead person was wealthy. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) tradition=전통 / mistake=실수 (B) indication=표시, 암시 / denial=부정 (C) entertainment=오락 / boredom=지루함
det.analysis:
① mistake—indication—boredom: (A) 여러 문화에서 발견되는 것은 '전통(tradition)'
② tradition—denial—entertainment: (B) 부유함의 '표시'이므로 indication
③ tradition—indication—entertainment: 매장 전통 + 부유함의 표시 + 오락 제공 ←정답
④ mistake—denial—boredom: 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 매장은 여러 문화의 전통(tradition) → 부유함의 표시(indication) → 사후 오락(entertainment) 제공

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the (A)[afterlife / present world], such as food, weapons, and clothing. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) afterlife=사후 세계 / present world=현세 (B) missing=없어진 / found=발견된 (C) power=권력 / weakness=약함
det.analysis:
① present world—found—power: (A) 죽은 자에게 필요한 것 → 사후 세계(afterlife)
② afterlife—found—weakness: (B) 판 자체는 '없어졌다'이므로 missing
③ present world—missing—weakness: (A)(C) 문맥과 반대
④ afterlife—missing—power: 사후 세계 + 판은 없어짐 + 사회적 지위와 권력 ←정답

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: educate(교육하다) → educated(교육받은). be동사 + 과거분사 수동/형용사 형태
det.analysis: educate를 과거분사 educated로 변환. 'someone who was educated'는 '교육받은 사람'을 뜻하는 수동 표현 — 주어가 교육을 '받는' 대상이므로 be + p.p.
det.tip: was _____ → 수동/상태 (be + p.p.) → educated(교육받은)

questions.passage: Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of __________ (bury) the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: bury(묻다) → burying(묻는 것). 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)
det.analysis: bury를 동명사 burying으로 변환. 'The purpose of burying the board game'은 '보드게임을 묻는 것의 목적'으로, 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사 역할을 하는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함
det.tip: 전치사(of) 뒤 → 동명사(-ing) → burying

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of __________ in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment in the next world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: health and happiness=건강과 행복 / social status and power=사회적 지위와 권력 / war and peace=전쟁과 평화 / art and music=예술과 음악
det.analysis:
① health and happiness: 뒤 문장(교육받고 일할 필요 없는 사람)과 안 맞음
② social status and power: 보드게임은 지위와 권력의 상징 — 교육받고 여유 있는 계층만 즐김 ←정답
③ war and peace: 전쟁·평화 언급 없음
④ art and music: 예술·음악 언급 없음
det.tip: 뒤 문장 'educated and didn't need to work(교육받고 일할 필요 없는)' 단서 → 지위와 권력

questions.passage: One tradition found in many ancient cultures is burying the dead with things they might need in the afterlife, such as food, weapons, and clothing. Archaeologists in western Norway, however, have found an unexpected item in a grave that dates back to the Early Iron Age — a board game. The board itself was missing, but the archaeologists found dice and game pieces. They believe that the board game was an indication that the dead person was wealthy. This is because board games were a symbol of social status and power in ancient civilizations. Only someone who was educated and didn't need to work could spend time playing them. The likely purpose of burying the board game was to provide the dead person with entertainment __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: for many years=여러 해 동안 / during the war=전쟁 중에 / in the next world=다음 세계(사후 세계)에서 / at the busy market=붐비는 시장에서
det.analysis:
① for many years: 오락을 여러 해 제공? 사후 맥락과 안 맞음
② during the war: 전쟁 언급 없음
③ in the next world: 죽은 자에게 사후 세계에서 오락을 제공 — 앞의 afterlife와 연결 ←정답
④ at the busy market: 시장 언급 없음
det.tip: burying the dead + afterlife 맥락 → the dead person에게 next world(다음 세계=사후)에서 제공
